strings.아이디어 · 산문 조건 · 화면 비율 · 1안 폼 / 2안 채팅: Idea · prose settings · aspect ratio · plan A form / plan B chat
strings.산문 작업공간 · 1안 버튼+옵션 / 2안 채팅: Prose workspace · plan A buttons + options / plan B chat
strings.이름 미정 · v18 Writer 러프 스토리보드 · Artist 그림이: Name TBD · v18 Writer rough storyboard · needs Artist images to enter
strings.이번 범위 밖 · 기존 유지: Out of scope this round · unchanged
strings.Producer는 두 화면. ① 이야기 재료(글 + 파일) ② 설정(장르: Producer is two screens. ① Story material (text + files) ② Settings (genre & mood · length · how much AI changes · aspect ratio) — settings arrive pre-filled with what the AI recommends after reading the text. Writer has one line above the prose (current conditions · [Write myself] · [AI rewrite ▾]) — options fold open under the rewrite button to pick and apply. Chat sits alongside.
strings.Producer는 채팅. 에이전트가 \"무엇을 만들까요?\"로 먼저 묻고: Producer is a chat. The agent opens with "What shall we make?"; you type straight into the input or attach a file with 📎, and if you have no idea yet, [Show me examples]. People who upload a file are first asked "How should we use it?" based on the material (film it as is / polish a little / make it new); people who only wrote text are asked genre → length → how much to change. Each card shows a recommendation. Writer happens in the same chat: the prose arrives as a card and is edited by chat.
strings.순서대로 넘어가요 · 지난 단계는 완료: Stages go in order · past stages are done
strings.Producer → Writer → Artist → Storyboard: Producer → Writer → Artist → Storyboard. Producer and Writer, once passed, aren't locked — they're "done": their work is finished, so later changes aren't synced back. Artist ⇄ Storyboard go back and forth.
strings.AI가 일하는 동안은 전체 잠금: Everything locks while the AI works
strings.AI 에이전트가 작업을 시작하면 화면 전체를 크게 로딩으로 덮고 모든 입: When the AI agent starts a job, a large loader covers the whole screen and all inputs are disabled. Edits wait until it finishes. No parallel jobs.
strings.Producer(진입)에서 정하고 시작하는 순간 잠긴다. 어떤 단계에서도: Chosen in Producer (entry) and locked the moment you start. No stage can change it.
No picker. Everything runs in the site language.
strings.인물·배경을 늘리려면 산문으로 롤백: To add cast or sets, roll back to the prose
strings.인물·배경 목록은 산문에서 나온다. Artist나 Storyboard에서: The cast and set list comes from the prose. If Artist or Storyboard needs a new character or place, go back to the Writer prose, edit it and break it down again. Character "looks" (outfit, age…) are added in Storyboard without a rollback.
strings.직접 고치기는 팝업에서: Manual edits happen in a popup
strings.사람이 손으로 고칠 때는 팝업을 띄우고 에이전트 채팅을 잠근다. 채팅과: When a person edits by hand, a popup opens and the agent chat is locked, so chat and hand edits never touch the same data at once.
strings.글을 적거나 파일을 올린다. 둘 다 안 해도 되는 건 파일뿐이고, 글은: Write text or upload a file. Only the file is optional; text must be over 20 characters (if there's a file, text can be empty). The image-rights consent is gone.
strings.\"무엇을 만들고 싶으세요?\" 형식 고르기 (단편/광고/MV…): "What would you like to make?" format picker (short film / ad / MV…)
strings.채팅 시작 · 무엇을 만들까요?: Chat start · What shall we make?
strings.에이전트가 먼저 묻는다: \"무엇을 만들까요? 자료가 있으면 올리거나 직: The agent asks first: "What shall we make? Upload material or type it in. No idea yet? I'll give you some examples." One button: [💡 Show me examples]. The chat input is small, chat-style, docked at the bottom.
strings.입력칸 안내: \"누가, 어디서, 무슨 일이, 어떻게 끝나는지 적어 주세: Input hint: "Who, where, what happens, and how it ends" (Enter to send · Shift+Enter for a new line)
strings.입력칸 아래: 📎 \"파일이 있으면 올려 주세요\" → 파일 첨부 팝업: Under the input: 📎 "Attach a file if you have one" → file upload popup
strings.[💡 예시 보여줘] 버튼, 또는 \"예시 보여줘\"라고 적어 보내도 됨: [💡 Show me examples] button, or just type "show me examples"
strings.최소 20자 규칙은 1안과 같음 · 글자 수 표시: Same 20-character rule as plan A · character count
strings.\"예시 보여줘\"를 누르거나 그렇게 적어 보내면 에이전트가 예시 3개를: Press "Show me examples" (or type it) and the agent shows three examples. Tapping one fills the input; edit it before sending if you like. [Other examples] swaps them.
strings.올릴 수 있는 파일을 먼저 보여준다. 글 파일(txt · md · doc: Shows what you can upload first: text files (txt · md · docx · pdf · hwp) and images that contain text (png · jpg — a photographed script, a memo screenshot). Up to 10MB.
Reading pictures — webtoons, character sheets, reference photos — is pushed to v2.
strings.팝업 안에 빨간 안내: \"이 파일은 올릴 수 없어요. txt · md: Red notice inside the popup: "This file can't be uploaded. Only txt · md · docx · pdf · hwp, or png · jpg images with text." Picking another file clears it.
strings.입력칸 아래 안내: \"조금 더 적어 주세요. 20자 이상이면 AI가 이: Notice under the input: "Tell me a little more — with 20+ characters the AI can find the story. (12 now)" The cursor moves to the input. In plan B the agent says the same in chat.
strings.AI가 글 읽고 추천 만드는 중: AI reading the text and drafting recommendations
strings.글과 파일을 읽는다. 이미지는 글자를 읽어 낸다. 읽은 내용으로 장르·분: Reads the text and files; images are OCR'd. From what it read it recommends genre & mood · length · how much to change.
strings.\"이미지에서 글을 찾지 못했어요. 글이 보이는 이미지나 글 파일을 올려: "I couldn't find any text in the image. Upload an image with visible text, or a text file." [Upload another file] / [Continue without the file].
strings.AI가 글을 읽고 고른 추천이 기본값으로 들어가 있고, 왜 그렇게 골랐는: The AI's picks are the defaults, each with a one-line reason. If they fit, just [Continue with AI].
strings.장르·분위기: 코미디 · 드라마 · 로맨스 · 스릴러 · 호러 · 액션: Genre & mood: comedy · drama · romance · thriller · horror · action · sci-fi/fantasy · mystery · human/family · slice of life
strings.AI 바꿈 정도 3단계: 1 그대로 · 2 다듬기 · 3 새롭게 키우기: How much the AI changes, 3 levels: 1 keep as is · 2 polish · 3 grow it new (each says what it keeps / changes). For a script file it becomes "How should we use your script? Film it as is / polish a little / make it new"
strings.3단계 이름: \"새롭게 키우기\"가 맞는지. 후보: 아이디어 더하기 ·: Level 3 name: is "Grow it new" right? Candidates: add ideas · grow it new · change freely.
strings.자료 확인 · 어떻게 쓸까요?: Material check · how should we use it?
strings.파일을 올린 사람만. 유저 플로우 정리본 \"글\" 영역처럼 자료 종류에: Only for people who uploaded a file. Asks by material type, as in the user-flow notes on "text". A script (1-1 · 1-2): "How should we use your script? Film it as is / polish a little / make it new"; an idea note (1-3) or image with text: "keep / polish / grow it new". The change level is settled here, so it isn't asked again later.
strings.1-1 영상까지 고려된 대본: 바로 영상화(그대로 샷으로) · 조금 다듬: 1-1 script already written for film: film as is (straight to shots) · polish a little (only what changed) · make it new
strings.1-2 일반 대본: 바로 영상화(빠진 연출·인물·배경만 채움) · 조금: 1-2 regular script: film as is (fills in missing direction, cast, sets) · polish a little · make it new
strings.목록 버튼에 추천 표시. [추천대로] 한 번이면 넘어간다. 말로 답해도: Recommendation marked on the list buttons. One tap on [As recommended] moves on. Answering in words works too; skipped if already clear from what you wrote.
Recommendation marked among under 15s / 15–60s / 1–5 min / 5–20 min.
strings.3단계 버튼마다 지켜요 / 바꿔요를 한 줄로. \"그대로\"는 지킬 원문: Each of the 3 buttons says in one line what it keeps / changes. "Keep as is" only appears when there's original text to keep.
strings.고르면 끝까지 못 바꾼다는 것을 카드 안에서 먼저 말한다. 실제 잠금은: Says up front, inside the card, that the choice can't be changed later. The actual lock happens at [Start] on the summary card.
strings.정리 카드 · Writer에게 넘기기: Summary card · hand off to Writer
Shows everything decided on one card with [✎ Ask Writer to write it]. Pressing it locks the aspect ratio; the prose-draft loading matches plan A. To change something, tap a summary chip above or just say it.
strings.\"시작하면 화면 비율은 바꿀 수 없어요.\" 정한 값을 한 번 더 보여: "Once you start, the aspect ratio can't be changed." Shows the chosen values one more time.
strings.재료와 설정으로 산문 트리트먼트 초안을 쓴다. 지금 제품에서는 Write: Writes a prose treatment draft from the material and settings — the job Writer 01–04 does in today's product.
With "keep as is", it goes to a read-only prose view that doesn't alter the original.
strings.이 화면은 산문만 다룬다. 러닝타임과 장르·분위기는 제목 아래 칩이 아니: This screen handles prose only. Running time and genre & mood aren't chips under the title — they're inputs to a rewrite. Plan A: prose + side chat, options fold out under [AI rewrite ▾]. Plan B: the same chat room as Producer — the prose arrives as a card in the chat with [Rewrite] [Edit myself] [Break it down]. The three revision options also arrive as chat cards.
strings.[AI 다시 쓰기] — 1안: 버튼 아래로 옵션 펼침 / 2안: 채팅 카: [AI rewrite] — plan A: options fold out under the button / plan B: chat card
strings.에이전트 채팅 (\"다시 써줘\" 또는 구체적인 요청): Agent chat ("rewrite it" or a specific request)
strings.제목 아래 설정 칩 (러닝타임·장르·스타일·포맷·톤·대사 언어·채팅 언어: Settings chips under the title (running time · genre · style · format · tone · dialogue language · chat language)
strings.대본을 그대로 쓰는 경우. 다시 쓰기와 직접 작성이 꺼져 있고, 원본을: When the script is used as is. Rewrite and manual editing are off; you review the original and can only break it down.
For 1-1-a: skip this screen entirely, or show it read-only?
strings.웹툰 2-2-a·b는 러닝타임 지정이 막힌다. 여기서 러닝타임 지표를 숨: Webtoons 2-2-a·b can't set a running time. Hide the running-time indicator here?
strings.다시 쓰기 옵션 (버튼 아래 펼침): Rewrite options (fold out under the button)
strings.산문 위 한 줄에는 지금 산문이 쓰인 조건만 글로 보인다(\"지금 산문: The line above the prose only states, in text, the conditions it was written under ("Current prose 15–60s · comedy · material kept"). [AI rewrite ▾] folds options open below: pick running time · genre & mood · material, then [Rewrite with these] applies them. Cancel changes nothing.
strings.조건은 다시 쓸 때만 바뀌어서, 조건과 산문이 어긋난 채 브레이크다운하는: Conditions only change through a rewrite, so prose and conditions can never drift apart before breakdown — no separate error screen needed (fixes today's error #3).
strings.\"다시 써줘\"라고 하면(2안은 [AI 다시 쓰기] 버튼도) 에이전트가: Say "rewrite it" (in plan B the [AI rewrite] button too) and the agent posts a card in chat asking: all of it, or just part?
strings.채팅 카드 안에서 러닝타임 · 장르·분위기 · 소재(그대로/새롭게)를 고: Inside the chat card, pick running time · genre & mood · material (keep/new), then [Rewrite].
strings.에이전트가 채팅으로 알린다: \"어느 부분을 고칠까요? 산문에서 문단을: The agent says in chat: "Which part should I change? Tap a paragraph in the prose and it attaches to the chat below. Tell me how to change it and send." Tapping a paragraph adds an "S2 ×" chip to the chat input; type the change and send. There's no extra input inside the card, so there's only ever one input. Only the chosen paragraphs are rewritten.
Panel or chat, same lock: full-screen loader, inputs disabled.
strings.기존 \"세 가지 안\" 그대로. 일부분이면 고른 문단만 바뀐 안이 나온: Today's "three options" as is. For a partial rewrite, only the chosen paragraphs differ. Apply one or discard.
Edit the prose by hand. The agent chat is locked while the popup is open.
strings.적용했어요 · 다음 단계로?: Applied · on to the next stage?
strings.수정안을 적용하거나 직접 고친 걸 저장하면, 에이전트가 채팅으로 먼저 제: After applying a revision or saving a manual edit, the agent suggests in chat: "Applied. Move on to the next stage? The prose will lock and Artist will pull the cast and sets." [Yes, break it down] / [No, keep editing].
strings.무엇을 더 해 볼까요?: What would you like to do?
strings.\"아니요\"를 고르면 에이전트가 다음 할 일을 버튼으로 보여준다. 어느: Choosing "No" makes the agent offer next steps as buttons. Whichever path you take, applying an edit asks "Move on to the next stage?" again, and it ends at the breakdown.
strings.다시 써 달라고 하기 (전부 · 일부분) → WC1: Ask for a rewrite (all · part) → WC1
strings.러닝타임 · 장르 바꿔서 다시 쓰기 → 1안: 다시 쓰기 옵션 / 2안:: Change running time / genre and rewrite → plan A: rewrite options / plan B: conditions card
strings.채팅으로 말할게요 → 산문 작업공간 (구체적 요청): I'll say it in chat → prose workspace (specific request)
strings.확정하면 바로 브레이크다운한다. 산문은 이때 잠긴다. 인물·배경을 늘리려: Confirming runs the breakdown immediately and locks the prose. It explains that adding cast or sets later means rolling back to the prose.
strings.확정 산문에서 인물 · 배경 · 인물별 상태(옷·나이 등. 기본/파생 구: From the locked prose, extracts cast · sets · each character's looks (outfit, age… no base/derived split) as text.
strings.인물·배경 디자인(Writer 07)이 Writer 02·03 없이 확정: Dev check: can cast & set design (Writer 07) run from the locked prose alone, without Writer 02·03?
strings.그림 없이 글로 된 인물·배경 목록. 카드가 아니라 한 줄씩 쌓이는 목록: Cast and sets as text, no images — a list, one row each, not cards. Each character's looks sit as chips (side by side, no base/derived split). An AI review note flags what might be missing.
strings.한 줄: 이름 · 인물/배경 · 설명 · 상태 칩 · [설명 고치기]: One row: name · cast/set · description · look chips · [Edit description]
strings.줄마다 레퍼런스 이미지 넣기 (＋ 올리기) — 그림 만들 때 이 인물·배: Reference image per row (＋ upload) — used only for that character/set when drawing
strings.\"진단\"을 AI가 목록을 점검해 메모로 보여주는 것으로 해석함. 맞는: Interpreting "diagnosis" as the AI checking the list and leaving a note. Confirm.
Can cast or sets be deleted here? (Deleting drifts from the prose.)
strings.목록을 보던 사용자가 이상함을 느껴 [인물·배경이 빠졌거나 겹쳤어요]를: Opens only when a user senses something off and taps [Cast or sets are missing or duplicated] (no check notice on the default screen). It asks instead of rolling back right away: if the word is already in the prose, re-check (prose stays locked, only the marks change); if the character/place isn't in the prose, rewrite (rollback).
strings.재점검 → 산문 표시 팝업(WT). 산문에 있는데 목록에 없거나, 한 사: Re-check → prose marking popup (WT). It's in the prose but missing from the list, or one person got split in two
strings.다시 쓰기 → 롤백(R1). 산문에 없는 인물·배경을 넣을 때: Rewrite → rollback (R1). Adding cast or sets that aren't in the prose
strings.그림을 만든 뒤(A5)에도 같은 질문. 재점검은 스타일·지금 그림을 그대: Same question after images exist (A5). Re-check keeps the style and current images and only fixes the list: new objects are auto-generated in the current style on [Apply to list]. When merging, pick the Team Lead image or the "Taem Lead" image; the unpicked one stays in history. Rewrite is R2 (rollback with images)
strings.사용자가 고른 재점검. 목록 위에 산문이 팝업으로 열린다. 산문은 잠긴: The re-check the user chose. The prose opens as a popup over the list, still locked, with only what the AI extracted marked as cast (blue) and places (green). Words the AI didn't recognise aren't marked (no guessy "needs checking" marks). Users select missed words in the prose and [Add], or [Edit] wrong names. [Apply to list] refills the Artist list from these marks.
strings.빠진 말 (예: 경비 아저씨): 산문에서 드래그해 고름 → [＋ 추가하기: Missed word (e.g. the security guard): drag-select in the prose → [＋ Add] → [Add as cast] / [Add as place]
strings.틀린 이름 (예: 틴장): 목록이나 산문의 표시를 눌러 [수정] → 이름: Wrong name (e.g. "Taem Lead"): tap the mark in the list or prose → [Edit] → fix the name. Renaming to an existing name (Team Lead) asks to merge, then merges into one
strings.수정 중에 [목록에서 빼기]도 할 수 있다: [Remove from list] is also available while editing
strings.빠지기 쉬운 것: 직함·대명사(그녀, 경비 아저씨) · 대사 속 호칭 ·: Easy to miss: titles & pronouns (she, the guard) · names inside dialogue · flashbacks & voices · groups (colleagues) · non-humans (the cat) · places only mentioned in dialogue
strings.둘로 갈라지기 쉬운 것: 오타(팀장/틴장) · 본명과 호칭(김민호/김 대: Easy to split in two: typos (Team Lead / Taem Lead) · real name vs title (Kim Minho / Assistant Kim) · nicknames · the same place spelled differently
strings.산문에 없는 말은 여기서 못 넣음 → [산문 다시 쓰기]: Words not in the prose can't be added here → [Rewrite prose]
When merging, should the prose spelling (the typo) also be corrected to the kept name?
Show the credit cost of auto-generated new objects on the [Apply to list] button?
strings.수정한 이름이 목록에 이미 있으면(틴장 → 팀장) 묻는다: \"틴장을 팀: If the edited name already exists (Taem Lead → Team Lead), it asks: "Merge Taem Lead into Team Lead?" Merged, they become one character and "Taem Lead" stays as an alias. If images already exist, pick [Team Lead image] / [Taem Lead image]; the other stays in history (clock icon). Cast and places can't be merged with each other.
strings.아직 그림이 없으니 잃는 것이 없다. Writer 산문이 다시 열리고,: No images yet, so nothing is lost. The Writer prose reopens; confirming runs the breakdown again.
strings.\"어떤 스타일로 만들까요?\" 재생성 팝업과 같은 모양. 스타일을 고르: "What style should we make it in?" — same shape as the regenerate popup. Pick a style, add style references (images whose look to follow), check count and estimated credits, then [Create]. One style per project; it can be re-picked later via regenerate.
Generates character sheets (with looks) and all sets in one style.
strings.생성한 그림을 카드로 보여준다. [모두 · 인물 · 배경] 탭. 위쪽에: Generated images as cards, with [All · Cast · Sets] tabs. Project style and version on top, with [Load] [Regenerate]. Tap a card for details. No [Add cast/set] button — instead [Cast or sets are missing or duplicated] at the bottom leads to re-check / rewrite (A1c). If any object lacks an image, [Finish] is disabled.
strings.재생성하기 → 스타일을 다시 고르고 전체를 새 버전으로: Regenerate → re-pick the style, whole set as a new version
strings.불러오기 → 이전 버전 통째로 (스타일도 그 버전으로): Load → a previous version wholesale (style included)
